title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Shortness of breath for the last two days.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents today with increased shortness of breath compared to baseline over the last two days. He reports this is associated with an increase in his usual orthopnea. He denies any fevers, chills, or chest pain. His current understanding of his chronic systolic heart failure is that it is being managed with his current regimen.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Carvedilol 12.5 mg twice daily
Furosemide 40 mg daily

Exam
Vitals are stable. Heart sounds are tachycardic with some S3 gallop noted. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. The patient appears comfortable at rest.

Assessment
The patient has chronic systolic heart failure, also referred to as HFrEF. He is currently stable today. We will monitor his symptoms and continue his current medication plan.

Plan
We will continue the current medications. The patient needs to monitor for any signs of worsening edema or dyspnea and call the office if symptoms increase. We will monitor his status at this visit.
explanations: The provider addressed chronic systolic heart failure at this visit, so it is supported: I50.22.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.
